claims.text: Stream A provides up to £200 for travel and accommodation for Genetics Society or Special Interest Group meetings.
Stream B provides up to £500 for non-Society genetics conferences.
Stream B provides up to £750 for two Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards a year for PhD students only.
Stream C provides up to £300 for registration for virtual conferences.
The funding supports attendance at Genetics Society or Special Interest Group meetings (Stream A).
The funding supports attendance at non-Genetics Society meetings (Stream B).
The funding supports attendance at virtual conferences (Stream C).

claims.text: Grants are available to support attendance at Genetics Society or Special Interest Group meetings.
Grants are available to support attendance at non-Genetics Society meetings.
Grants are available to support attendance at virtual conferences.
Scheme (A) is open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva.
Scientists who obtained their PhD more than six years ago are not eligible for Scheme (A).
Schemes (B) & (C) are open to PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva.
Undergraduate or Master’s students are not eligible for Schemes (B) & (C).
Scientists who obtained their PhD more than six years ago are not eligible for Schemes (B) & (C).
Schemes (B) & (C) are open to UK-based members wishing to attend conferences outside of the UK.
Schemes (B) & (C) are open to non-UK-based members wishing to attend a conference in the UK.
Applications from bases outside the UK for conference attendance outside the UK cannot be considered.
A maximum of one grant per two years will be awarded for applications to Scheme (B) or (C).
Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
Supervisors providing support letters must be current members of the Genetics Society and include their membership number.
Grant recipients will be asked to write a short report.
Grants up to £200 are available for travel and accommodation for Genetics Society or SIG meetings.
There is no limit to the frequency that Scheme (A) grants can be applied for.
Grants of up to £500 are available for travel, accommodation, and registration at non-Genetics Society meetings.
Up to two Scheme B grants per year will be co-sponsored by the Adelphi Genetics Forum.
Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards can provide up to £750.
Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards are only open to registered PhD student members who will take up the award before their PhD graduation date.
If unsuccessful for the Adelphi Genetics Forum award, applications will be considered for a standard Scheme B grant up to £500.
Grants of up to £300 are available to cover registration costs for virtual conferences.
The virtual conference grant is available to UK-based members for genetics-related virtual conferences anywhere.
The virtual conference grant is available to non-UK-based members for UK-based Genetics related virtual conferences.
Applications should be submitted by bi-monthly deadlines: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December.
Applications should be made by logging into the mySociety membership portal.
The conference must take place AFTER the application deadline.
For Genetics Society and SIG meetings, applications should be submitted online before the registration deadline of the meeting.
Queries regarding the application process can be directed to theteam@genetics.org.uk.
The supervisor’s supporting statement must be uploaded along with the online application before the deadline.
